Case disposition

What disposition, if any, may the platform reach without a human? The agent recommendation is one input among many and is never authority. The only automatic disposition this table can produce is APPROVED, and only for an attested low-risk cohort with every approval requirement satisfied. No row produces DECLINED.

Does the case hold enough policy context, screening coverage, investigation work and evidence for a recommendation to be worth making? This gate judges completeness, never the merits. It does not look at the recommendation, which does not exist yet.

Customer cohorts

The risk and failure cohorts the golden corpus must cover and the policy gates reason about. A risk cohort is assigned from stable case attributes and decides which evidence obligations apply and whether automatic approval is even in scope. A failure cohort describes a way the case or the platform can go wrong; each one has a required outcome that evaluation must reproduce.

The institution-reviewable inventory of US KYC rules this platform enforces or contributes evidence toward.
